description: List every difference between the inducible Mal23p and the constitutive Mal23-Cp to locate the constitutive lesion
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVBZX*"; IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
import numpy as np
b=np.load if False else None
# reuse simple identity-matrix alignment is unnecessary: lengths 470 vs 468, do banded NW with BLOSUM62
exec(open("mal33_alignment_analysis.py").read().split("# ---- MAIN")[0]) if False else None

def seq(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

m23  = seq("E9P8G2")   # MAL23  inducible, functional
m23c = seq("E9P8G1")   # MAL23-C constitutive
m33  = seq("P38157")   # MAL33  non-functional, S288C
m63  = seq("E9P8G3")   # MAL63  inducible, functional

# simple global alignment with a fixed 2-aa gap expected: use difflib-free banded NW (identity scoring is enough here)
def nw_simple(a,bq,gap=-6):
    n,m=len(a),len(bq)
    sc=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    sc[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap; sc[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap
    ptr[1:,0]=1; ptr[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=sc[i-1,j-1]+(2 if ai==bq[j-1] else -2)
            u=sc[i-1,j]+gap; l=sc[i,j-1]+gap
            k=int(np.argmax((d,u,l))); sc[i,j]=(d,u,l)[k]; ptr[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=ptr[i,j]
        if p==0: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append(bq[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append("-");i-=1
        else: A.append("-");B.append(bq[j-1]);j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(B))

def diffs(a,bq,labA,labB):
    A,B=nw_simple(a,bq); pa=pb=0; out=[]
    for ca,cb in zip(A,B):
        if ca!="-": pa+=1
        if cb!="-": pb+=1
        if ca!=cb: out.append((pa if ca!="-" else None, ca, cb, pb if cb!="-" else None))
    print(f"\n{labA} ({len(a)} aa) vs {labB} ({len(bq)} aa): {len(out)} differences, "
          f"{100*(1-len(out)/max(len(a),len(bq))):.1f}% identity")
    return out

d = diffs(m23, m23c, "Mal23p inducible", "Mal23-Cp constitutive")
print("position_in_Mal23p  Mal23p -> Mal23-Cp")
for pa,ca,cb,pb in d:
    print(f"   {str(pa):>4s}            {ca} -> {cb}")
pos=[pa for pa,ca,cb,pb in d if pa]
print(f"\nAll {len(d)} Mal23p->Mal23-Cp changes lie between residues {min(pos)} and {max(pos)}")
print(f"Changes in 1-299 (DNA binding + transactivation + inhibitory): {sum(1 for p in pos if p<300)}")
print(f"Changes in 300-470 (maltose-responsive domain):               {sum(1 for p in pos if p>=300)}")

# does the Mal23-C C-terminus match MAL33 rather than MAL23?
A,B = nw_simple(m23c, m33)
pa=pb=0; rows=[]
for ca,cb in zip(A,B):
    if ca!="-": pa+=1
    if cb!="-": pb+=1
    rows.append((pa,ca,cb))
print("\nIn the region where Mal23-Cp departs from Mal23p, which allele does it match?")
A2,B2 = nw_simple(m23c, m23)
pa=0; m_to_23=[]; 
for ca,cb in zip(A2,B2):
    if ca!="-": pa+=1
    m_to_23.append((pa,ca==cb))
d23 = {p:ok for p,ok in m_to_23}
d33 = {}
pa=0
for ca,cb in zip(A,B):
    if ca!="-": pa+=1
    d33[pa]=(ca==cb)
seg=[p for p in sorted(d23) if p>=300]
agree33=sum(1 for p in seg if d33.get(p))
agree23=sum(1 for p in seg if d23.get(p))
print(f"  Mal23-Cp residues 300-{len(m23c)}: identical to Mal33p at {agree33}/{len(seg)} "
      f"({100*agree33/len(seg):.1f}%), identical to its Mal23p parent at {agree23}/{len(seg)} "
      f"({100*agree23/len(seg):.1f}%)")

# figure: match-to-Mal23p vs match-to-Mal33p along Mal23-Cp
xs=np.arange(1,len(m23c)+1)
y23=np.array([1.0 if d23.get(p) else 0.0 for p in xs]); y33=np.array([1.0 if d33.get(p) else 0.0 for p in xs])
W=15; k=np.ones(W)/W
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.6))
ax.plot(xs,100*np.convolve(y23,k,mode="same"),color="#e67e22",lw=2,label="Mal23-Cp matches Mal23p (its inducible parent)")
ax.plot(xs,100*np.convolve(y33,k,mode="same"),color="#c0392b",lw=2,label="Mal23-Cp matches Mal33p (non-functional, S288C)")
ax.axvline(316.5,color="k",ls="--",lw=1.3)
ax.axvspan(316.5,len(m23c),color="#c0392b",alpha=0.09)
ax.text(392,104,"Mal23-Cp = Mal33p here",ha="center",color="#c0392b",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel("Mal23-Cp residue (E9P8G1)"); ax.set_ylabel("identity, 15-residue window (%)")
ax.set_title("The constitutive MAL23-C allele carries a Mal33p-type C-terminal maltose-responsive domain")
ax.set_ylim(0,118); ax.set_xlim(1,len(m23c)); ax.legend(fontsize=9,loc="lower left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
